name: Block b
idea: The wordmark’s first move: the b’s stem plus a pink block for the bowl. The icon spells the brand and is the block.

name: Splice
idea: One block cut down the middle, its halves from two sources and slipped out of line, like two records cut together on the beat.
body: <rect width="1024" height="1024" rx="230" fill="#17121A"/><defs><clipPath id="splicel"><rect x="0" y="0" width="500" height="1024"/></clipPath><clipPath id="splicer"><rect x="524" y="0" width="500" height="1024"/></clipPath></defs><rect x="232" y="200" width="560" height="560" rx="42.0" fill="#FBF8F9" clip-path="url(#splicel)"/><rect x="232" y="264" width="560" height="560" rx="42.0" fill="#FF69B4" clip-path="url(#splicer)"/>

name: Crossfade
idea: Two blocks overlap and the mix happens where they meet. The most literal mix, but overlaps can call Mastercard to mind.
body: <rect width="1024" height="1024" rx="230" fill="#17121A"/><defs><clipPath id="crossfadea"><rect x="192" y="352" width="400" height="400" rx="30.0" fill="#000"/></clipPath></defs><rect x="192" y="352" width="400" height="400" rx="30.0" fill="#FBF8F9"/><rect x="432" y="272" width="400" height="400" rx="30.0" fill="#FF69B4"/><rect x="432" y="272" width="400" height="400" rx="30.0" fill="#FDB0D6" clip-path="url(#crossfadea)"/>

name: Crossfader
idea: A DJ mixer’s crossfader. Two source blocks sit at the ends of a track and the pink block is the knob between them.

name: Square vinyl
idea: A record made of blocks: grooves are nested rounded squares and the label is the pink block.

name: Interlock
idea: Two pieces from different sources locking into one solid square. Puzzle and Tetris energy.

name: Drop row
idea: The cover idea: a row of three with the pink block dropping into its slot in the middle.

name: Tracklist
idea: A page as stacked sections. The pink one has been sampled in and still sits slightly out of line.
